A '''holo-brochure''' was an informative [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] document typically used to advertise a company, organization or resort. The [[Ace of Sabres]], a landmark of modern entertainment situated on [[Kluistar]], was advertised with holo-brochures, which claimed it would take visitors a standard month to fully experience its attractions.
